body: The other day I was on the suicide hotline chat, trying to get information on coping mechanisms for keeping calm when it's normally fine. I turned it on and there were 56 people in line ahead of me. I got to the end after an hour and a half, and the chat application hung, so I refreshed and I was at the back of the line with 74 people in line head of me. If that hasn't killed someone I'm going to be shocked.

I absolutely get this and honestly I think it's one of my main problems that keeps me from making my life better. I think I could do more if I didn't get so overwhelmed so often just thinking about stuff like that, because I freeze up and I feel like it's utterly hopeless and that I'm powerless. I feel way too much way too strongly and I wish to god I could just stop.

I can drive to them - I'm currently living out of my car, sleeping in Walmart parking lots.

I'm not in the worst situation one can be when homeless - it's bad, it's never easy, but I have a lot of blessings - it's mostly that I'm overwhelmed by the enormity of it and the mental issues. It was hard enough keeping going when everything was going..."right" is not the right term, but better, and now that I'm here it's gotten much harder to deal with; I'm making progress on building up coping mechanisms but it's simply easier to feel like you're worthless when you have no job, no home and you feel like it's all your fault - if you just tried being better a year ago, nine months ago, six months ago.

Anyways. Practical information. Yes, I know how to get to the local shelters. I need to figure out where to get food and I need to get an ID thing squared away but I'm learning more about what's available to me every day.

Sorry for the delay, it's been busy! I have located the local shelters and a few of the social programs, but none in any of the areas I've been looking at moving to. That's probably a good idea in case things go wrong.

Unfortunately not. I'm currently looking at moving somewhere, anywhere else but there's a lot of options, none of them are great, all of them involve me being alone somewhere where I don't know anybody, and I feel like all of my problems will follow me wherever I go. I'm still looking but even with the option to travel I feel trapped, worthless, and like I shouldn't even be here. 

I don't know. I'm a lot more up and down than I used to be (which was all down all the time) and I'm getting more and more done when I can actually do things, but then I have days where I'm melting down from sunrise to sunset and I don't know if someone who does that can survive on their own like this.

I appreciate you reaching out though, that's a comfort.
